blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Businessman Joseph Sy, who is facing questions over his citizenship, snubbed the Senate panel on justice and human rights on Thursday, after he was taken to the emergency room earlier in the day. Sy’s legal counsel, lawyer Alma Mallonga, told the panel that her client had a “genuine desire to participate” in the proceedings, and suggested that he may have been under stress following his release from immigration detention, where he had been held for more than 491 days.
